criteria.criterion: In docs/spec.toml the OLY-B-O1-01 entry no longer has mechanism = "none"; it names athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range (rule M6), keeps owner = "Athena", and its measure ends with `status: not shown` and names the test that shows it.
criteria.evidence: The diff of docs/spec.toml:2164-2166 shows mechanism = "athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range (rule M6): ..." and owner = "Athena" (unchanged). The measure names `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap`, crates/athena-gate/tests/bootstrap_requirement.rs and the hestia test, and ends `; status: not shown`. The statement line is unchanged. spec_entry_names_the_bootstrap_range_gate passed, and so did the hestia test, which asserts measure_problem is None and the id is not in spec_gaps.

criteria.criterion: A new test file under crates/athena-gate/tests/ reads docs/spec.toml, fails if the OLY-B-O1-01 entry has mechanism "none", lacks the mechanism name, owner or the `status: not shown` ending; run `cargo test -p athena-gate`. It fails on the base tree and passes with the change.
criteria.evidence: crates/athena-gate/tests/bootstrap_requirement.rs reads ../../docs/spec.toml and checks for a mechanism that is not none, the gate name, owner Athena and the `status: not shown` ending. `cargo test -p athena-gate` passed: 141 lib tests and 3 new tests. Athena's fails-without-2 run on the base spec failed with exit 101: spec_entry_names_the_bootstrap_range_gate panicked with "mechanism is blank or none". base_entry_is_rejected passes, which shows the checker rejects the base text.

criteria.criterion: The same test (or the existing invariant test) shows the gate accepts an `Athena-Job: bootstrap` commit while the range is open and refuses one after records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json closes it; run `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap`.
criteria.evidence: The filtered run passed invariant::tests::bootstrap_commits_pass_while_the_range_is_open_and_not_after. That test (invariant.rs:1102-1122) asserts no violations while the range is open and at the closing commit, then exactly one violation for a late bootstrap commit. The run also passed the new bootstrap_range_is_open_then_closed_by_the_outcome_record, which sees Open and then ClosedThrough(first commit).

findings.summary: The spec-entry checker's test-name check is loose
findings.evidence: check_entry only requires that the measure contains the word 'bootstrap'. It does not check for the test file name or the cargo command. The hestia test and the exact-text diff make up for this.

summary: The change does what the request asked. The OLY-B-O1-01 entry in docs/spec.toml now names `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range (rule M6)` as its mechanism, keeps owner "Athena", and has a measure that names the tests and ends with `status: not shown`. The measure also says the "v0 stays small" part is prose only. The gate itself is unchanged; only a doc comment was added. I ran the new test file (3 tests pass), `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap` (the existing rule-M6 refusal test and the new open/closed range test pass), `cargo test -p athena-core oly_b_o1_01` (passes) and the full `cargo test -p athena-gate` (144 tests pass). Athena's fails-without runs show `spec_entry_names_the_bootstrap_range_gate` fails on the base spec (exit 101, "mechanism is blank or none"). CI recorded fmt, clippy and the workspace tests as passing. The evidence snapshot has records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json, so the real range is closed, which fits the mechanism. Two changed files are outside the expected-deliverables list: crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (a test only) and xtask/shard-timings.txt (needed by the shard-timing test). Both were in the planned files and neither is harmful, so I rate them minor.
